_readme: MANUAL OVERRIDES. This layer pins hand-adjusted figures so the mechanical calculation can never silently overwrite a known, deliberate exception. Keys are ACCC case numbers exactly as shown on the register (e.g. 'MN-65028'). Any key beginning with an underscore is IGNORED (these notes and the example below). For each real case-number key you may set any of: reviewComplete (true/false), determinationDate ('YYYY-MM-DD'), durationBusinessDays (a number, or the string '—' for an em dash), status (string), notes (string, shown as a small 'manual' tag on that row). Pipeline order: scrape -> compute mechanically -> merge these on top, so the fields you set here always win. To activate a placeholder below, RENAME its key from the 'REPLACE-...' text to the real case number and fill in the values; delete any placeholder you don't need.

MN-00000.notes: Example only — this key starts under _example so it is ignored. Copy this shape to a top-level real case number to use it.

REPLACE-with-case-number-saturday-effect.notes: Saturday effective date: firm counts the clock from the following Monday, so the mechanical result is off by the weekend. Enter the firm's corrected business-day count here.

REPLACE-with-case-number-suspended-show-.notes: Assessment suspended — show an em dash for duration even though the matter is otherwise marked complete.

REPLACE-with-case-number-clock-stopped-s.notes: Review clock stopped — show an em dash for duration despite the completed marking.

REPLACE-with-case-number-not-authorised-.notes: Non-standard determination ('Not authorised to open'). Duration set manually and is unverifiable — pinned here.
